#!/bin/sh
# Policy routing + health check. A (198.51.100.0/24)->WAN1, B (198.51.200.0/24)->WAN2, failover to the other link.
A=198.51.100.0/24; B=198.51.200.0/24

up() { ping -c2 -W1 -I "$2" "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

ensure_rule $A 101 100; ensure_rule $B 102 200
up $GW1 $IF1 && U1=1 || U1=0
up $GW2 $IF2 && U2=1 || U2=0

  if [ "$5" = 1 ] || [ "$8" != 1 ]; then ip route replace "$2" via "$3" dev "$4" table "$1"
  else ip route replace "$2" via "$6" dev "$7" table "$1"; fi
}
set_route 101 $A $GW1 $IF1 $U1 $GW2 $IF2 $U2
set_route 102 $B $GW2 $IF2 $U2 $GW1 $IF1 $U1

[Install]
